E1.title: THE ACCEPTED VOICE
E1.text: The voice stops pretending to be outside your mind. It settles into your thoughts, speaking with your own memories and your own fears. You leave the room, but you can no longer tell which ideas were ever yours.

E2.title: THE ARGUMENT
E2.text: You demand answers from the darkness. The voice replies with every secret you tried to forget, until the room becomes silent and your own reflection begins to answer instead.

E3.title: THE EMPTY ROOM
E3.text: You search every corner and find nothing except a recording of your own voice asking the same questions. The room was never hiding something from you. It was waiting for you to notice yourself.

E4.title: THE OTHER SIDE
E4.text: Your fingers pass through the mirror like water. Something on the other side holds your hand, and the reflection smiles before you do.

E5.title: THE COVERED GLASS
E5.text: The mirror disappears beneath the cloth, but the shape beneath it still moves every night. The cover hides the glass, not the presence behind it.

E6.title: THE HIDDEN FRAME
E6.text: Behind the mirror you find a second room identical to yours. Inside that room, another version of you is searching for the mirror.

E7.title: THE RETURNED MEMORY
E7.text: You recover memories that feel ancient but belong to yesterday. The final memory is the moment you entered the room for the first time, and you are still standing at the door.

E8.title: THE BLANK MIND
E8.text: You erase the thought completely. For a moment there is peace, until you realize you have forgotten why you wanted to escape.

E9.title: THE FINAL THOUGHT
E9.text: You follow the impossible idea until it leads back to yourself. The room was a prison, but the prisoner was never the person you believed.

G1.title: THE EXIT
G1.text: You escape the room, but the silence follows you home. Every night you hear a door open somewhere inside your thoughts.

G2.title: THE LAST RESISTANCE
G2.text: You fight the presence until nothing remains but a quiet mind. In the morning, you discover the room has vanished, along with every record that you existed.

G3.title: THE FINAL MESSAGE
G3.text: The voice speaks one last sentence, using words you do not remember teaching it. Then it disappears, leaving only the fear that it was telling the truth.
